description: This file defines a Java class PreferenceServices that provides various static methods for managing user preferences in an Apache OFBiz-based system. It includes functions to get, set, remove, copy user preferences and preference groups, interacting with the database/entities and handling data conversions. The class serves as a service layer for user preference operations.

classes.name: PreferenceServices
classes.description: Contains static service methods for managing user preferences in OFBiz.

methods.name: getUserPreference
methods.description: Fetches a single user preference based on userPrefTypeId and optionally userPrefGroupTypeId for the current or specified user.

methods.name: getUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a group of preferences for a user, optionally filling defaults from general properties.

methods.name: setUserPreference
methods.description: Stores or updates a single user preference key-value pair.

methods.name: setUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Stores multiple user preferences as a group.

methods.name: copyUserPreferenceGroup
methods.description: Copies all preferences from one user/group to another.
